boundaries.note: Historical public accepted source/object/closure bindings only. Actual reused objects and recursively valid compile records must be matched separately. This file gives no new acceptance and does not establish those physical objects are present.

comparison_contract.on_mismatch: Report exact module and differing fields. Do not automatically recompile or replay the accepted prefix.
physical_files: SHA-256 of the active source file must equal source_sha256
SHA-256 of the actual .olean selected by LEAN_PATH must equal object_sha256
record_validation: Require successful existing compile record (exit_code = 0) with the expected pinned toolchain
Validate project dependency records recursively: compare dependency object hashes and dependency_signatures against the actual imported sources and objects
Recompute closure_signature from its original recorded schema payload; require equality to both its stored value and compile_closure_signature here
Retain historical provenance; copying or matching a cache object gives no new compilation, replay, audit or proof credit
